targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(total_cost_usd)::numeric, 2), 0) FROM dashboard_cost_history WHERE date::date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(session_count), 0) FROM dashboard_cost_history WHERE date::date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND((SUM(input_tokens) + SUM(output_tokens))::numeric / 1000000, 1), 0) FROM dashboard_cost_history WHERE date::date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date
SELECT date::date AS time, provider AS metric, total_cost_usd AS value FROM dashboard_cost_history ORDER BY date

SELECT date_trunc('hour', to_timestamp(started_at/1000)) AS time, COUNT(*) AS value FROM scheduler_runs WHERE task_group = 'llm' AND started_at > (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') * 1000) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date, provider, total_cost_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens, session_count FROM dashboard_cost_history ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 20
